# Erika Life | Bounce Experiences

> Rebound boots (jumping boots) fitness classes in Cairo, Egypt, with Hungarian coach Erika Szenes. "Where joy meets power. Where souls go back to nature." From Hungary to Egypt, from Egypt to worldwide.

## Key facts
- Brand: Erika Life | Bounce Experiences (formerly Erika | Bounce Fit Boots)
- Coach: Erika Szenes, Hungarian coach; 20+ years in fitness and wellness; background in choreography and classical, modern and show ballet; 15+ years bringing her experience from Hungary to Egypt
- Languages: English, Hungarian, Arabic
- What: 60-minute fitness dancing classes on rebound boots (jumping boots, bounce boots). All classes use basic movements.
- Levels: Beginner "Find your bounce" (soft bounce, bounce march, heel tap, side step); Intermediate "Build your power" (knee lift, swing kick, scissor step, hip twist); Advanced "Let it fly" (star jump, sprint knees, squat to lift, turn combo)
- Music: Latin, Masry and remixes
- Price: December 2026 special, 500 EGP per class instead of 850 EGP, limited time
- Next class: Tuesday 1 December 2026, 7 PM Cairo time, 60 minutes, at Heliopolis Sporting Club (https://maps.app.goo.gl/rBn8nqgbo6acWSmJ9), Heliopolis Club members only. 11 spots, one per pair of boots (S 2, M 8, L 1)
- Bounce experiences: every class is a bounce experience in a new place, with new people. No fixed studio for now; through December 2026 each one appears in the calendar on the home and booking pages and is announced in the Erika Life community first
- Boots: provided in S (EU 36–37), M (EU 38–39) and L (EU 40–42); XS and XL are not in class stock, bring your own; you can always bring your own boots
- Own boots for sale: Basic full black 16,000 EGP; Modified coloured springs 18,000 EGP; Special edition with a coloured shell or coloured lines 20,000 EGP; Kids 16,000 EGP; Luxury mirrored edition 25,000 EGP. Reserve with a 50% InstaPay deposit, balance on delivery.
- Booking: pick a boots size on the booking page to reserve a spot, pay with InstaPay, share the payment screenshot on WhatsApp; confirmation follows by email and WhatsApp

## Pages
- [Home](https://erikalife.com/): welcome, choose your feeling (free, joyful, powerful), Erika's three beats "Land soft. Rise strong. Bloom.", Meet Erika, back to nature, three levels, next class countdown, FAQ
- [Book a class](https://erikalife.com/booking.html): next class, boots size (one pair = one spot), December price, name, WhatsApp, email, club membership number, InstaPay payment

- [Get your own boots](https://erikalife.com/boots.html): five editions with colours, size chart, 50% InstaPay deposit
